title: Domain-joined systems must use Windows 11 Enterprise Edition 64-bit version.
evidence: Domain-joined only (check text: "For standalone systems, this is NA"). Image is Pro, standalone.

title: Windows 11 systems must have a Trusted Platform Module (TPM) enabled.
evidence: TPM 2.0 required by Windows 11 Setup and by the BIOS settings table in docs/GUIDE.md, step 11 (TPM enabled); validator "TPM ready" row FAILs otherwise.

title: Windows 11 systems must have Unified Extensible Firmware Interface (UEFI) firmware and be configured to run in UEFI mode, not Legacy BIOS.
evidence: UEFI-only boot media (oscdimg UEFI, 2023-CA boot manager); Secure Boot/VBS need UEFI; validator checks Secure Boot.

title: Secure Boot must be enabled on Windows 11 systems.
evidence: docs/GUIDE.md, step 11: Secure Boot enabled; VBS policy RequirePlatformSecurityFeatures=1; validator "Secure Boot" row FAILs if off.

title: Windows 11 information systems must use BitLocker to encrypt all disks to protect the confidentiality and integrity of all information at rest.
evidence: BitLocker is a deliberate manual step (Enable-BitLocker.cmd, TPM-only). Not encrypted at image time; validator reports BitLocker-off only as INFO.

title: Windows 11 systems must use a BitLocker PIN for pre-boot authentication.
evidence: Kit decision "BitLocker TPM-only" (docs/dev/DECISIONS.md, Set-KitRegistry UseTPMPIN=2/UseTPMKeyPIN=2: PIN allowed, not required). STIG requires PIN required (1).

title: Windows 11 systems must use a BitLocker PIN with a minimum length of six digits for pre-boot authentication.
evidence: FVE\MinimumPIN not set (follows from TPM-only; PIN optional via Enable-BitLockerLocal -StartupPin).

title: The operating system must employ a deny-all, permit-by-exception policy to allow the execution of authorized software programs.
evidence: No AppLocker/App Control allowlisting: SECURITY-BASELINE.md "considered, not adopted: Smart App Control and App Control for Business (block own unsigned dev builds)"; Smart App Control off (decision).

title: Windows 11 systems must be maintained at a supported servicing level.
evidence: 26H2 (support to ~2028-10 for Pro), monthly rebuild with the current LCU, Windows Update on, feature version pinned to 26H2 (TargetReleaseVersion).

title: The Windows 11 system must use an antivirus program.
evidence: Defender Antivirus GPO (real-time on, cloud protection, PUA); kit adds PUAProtection, signature update at first logon; validator checks real-time protection.

title: Local volumes must be formatted using NTFS.
evidence: Windows Setup formats the OS volume NTFS (disk selection is interactive). Caveat: a Dev Drive (ReFS) or exFAT data volume with a drive letter would be a finding.

title: Alternate operating systems must not be permitted on the same system.
evidence: Single Windows install, no other boot entries (WSL distros are not alternate boot OSes).

title: Non-system-created file shares on a system must limit access to groups that require it.
evidence: Kit creates no shares; only ADMIN$/C$/IPC$ exist on a clean install (NA). Keep it that way when sharing folders later.

title: Only accounts responsible for the administration of a system must have Administrator rights on the system.
evidence: Decision: standard daily account LocalUser (Users) + separate LocalAdmin (Administrators), autounattend.

title: Only accounts responsible for the backup operations must be members of the Backup Operators group.
evidence: Backup Operators is empty on a clean install; kit adds nobody.

title: Only authorized user accounts must be allowed to create or run virtual machines on Windows 11 systems.
evidence: No hosted hypervisor role (decision: WSL + VMP only, image.json mustNotBeEnabled Hyper-V); Hyper-V Administrators unused.

title: Standard local user accounts must not exist on a system in a domain.
evidence: Domain only (check text: standalone is Not Applicable).

title: Accounts must be configured to require password expiration.
evidence: Depends on whether Setup creates the unattend LocalAccounts with "Password never expires"; not set by the kit. Moot in practice: the kit sets maxpwage unlimited (see V-253301). Check: Get-LocalUser | ft Name,PasswordExpires,PasswordNeverExpires on the PC.

title: Permissions for system files and directories must conform to minimum requirements.
evidence: Default file-system ACLs kept (kit only tightens C:\ProgramData\W11Kit); EveryoneIncludesAnonymous=0 by default (V-253455), which the check says makes defaults compliant.

title: Internet Information System (IIS) or its subcomponents must not be installed on a workstation.
evidence: IIS is an optional feature, off by default; image.json enables only WSL + VirtualMachinePlatform.

title: Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) must not be installed on the system.
evidence: SNMP is a Feature on Demand, not installed by default; kit adds no capabilities.

title: Simple TCP/IP Services must not be installed on the system.
evidence: Simple TCP/IP Services is an optional feature, off by default.

title: The Telnet Client must not be installed on the system.
evidence: Telnet Client is an optional feature, off by default.

title: The TFTP Client must not be installed on the system.
evidence: TFTP Client is an optional feature, off by default.

evidence: Procedural: no .p12/.pfx shipped by the kit; a dev machine may accumulate them (dev/code-signing certs) - keep them out of the file system or in a password manager.

title: A host-based firewall must be installed and enabled on the system.
evidence: Windows Firewall enabled for Domain/Private/Public profiles by the baseline (inbound block, logging).
